title: FAITHFULNESS: MigratorV2V3 documented in-contract recovery path is unreachable while bricked (story-023)
description: story-023 NatSpec offers an in-contract escape from a reverting reward recipient ('exclude such addresses from the seed list'), but the same document forbids mid-pass reseeding and the L114 reseed guard (require !seeded || migrateIterator == -1) enforces it. A revert pins migrateIterator so it never reaches -1, making the documented recovery unreachable; withdrawAll does not reset the pass. Only true recovery is a full redeploy + setMigrator rewire.
impact: Spec self-contradiction: the story overstates in-contract recoverability. Standalone Low (faithfulness). Security impact owned by M-01 (no double-count).
recommendation: Correct the NatSpec to state the real recovery (full redeploy + rewire), or make the code match the documented escape (allow a controlled mid-pass reseed).
securityCrossRef: M-01 (V3-M-01, DEDUP-02) — owns the DoS severity.
priorArtCrossRef: ledger V2-M-01 (same availability-DoS class, retired V1->V2 migrator)
